name: tt-lora-train
description: Train LoRA adapters on Tenstorrent hardware and prove the result with an honest metric and a baseline-parity table. Use for LoRA fine-tuning on TT silicon, or for validating whether a TT-trained adapter matches a CUDA-trained baseline.

interface.displayName: TT LoRA Training and Parity Proof
interface.shortDescription: Train LoRA on TT silicon and prove parity with an honest metric
interface.longDescription: Bring up LoRA training on Tenstorrent hardware through tt-blacksmith or tt-metal's tt-train, gate every result on a fixed-window honest metric and a held-out carve, and produce a baseline-parity table that names its own negatives. Closes the gap in the ecosystem where training publishes loss curves but no downstream accuracy.
defaultPrompt: Use lora-train to bring up LoRA training on this Tenstorrent device and prove the result with an honest metric.
Use lora-train to compare a TT-trained LoRA against my CUDA-trained baseline on the same held-out carve.
